title: what kind of app for trading do you use ??
author: BlackberryOdd9237
selftext:
I wonder what you hate about that app. I'd like you to tell me what's irritating you on industry giants like TradingView, NinjaTrader, FX Replay, Zella, and other trading platforms. First things first, every single one of them uses AI alongside developers, but those people don't care about what YOU want. There is a lot of AI slop today, so people just assume that anyone trying to develop something NEW today is automatically a red flag, without even knowing anything about it. Even though I know you are all sensitive to stuff like this because of various gurus and things like that, I don't promote or ask you to do anything.

 I just want you to tell me: what would you like to see in the trading space that you CAN'T find on **mass-used** platforms?

comments.author: QSignalFX
comments.body: No app. IB Gateway headless on a small Linux box, my own Python on top, and a Telegram message when it does something. The "app" is a log file.
